description: This file is a configuration script for ESLint, specifically configured for a Svelte project using TypeScript. It imports various plugins and configs, and exports an ESLint configuration object tailored to the project files, including .svelte and TypeScript files, while excluding certain config files.

methods.name: ts.config
methods.description: Generates or combines ESLint configurations specific to TypeScript, integrating recommended settings and custom configs.

methods.name: includeIgnoreFile
methods.description: Includes ignore patterns from a specified ignore file into the ESLint configuration.
